blurb: Guests can enjoy locally brewed craft beer, food in the eatery, and bowling with lane rentals at Kelowna, Vernon, and Penticton locations. Bowling includes traditional 10-pin and duckpin options with food and drink service at the lanes. Reservations are recommended for bowling and dining, with separate bookings required for each.
